notes: v1.14.530 — COMMAND LABEL TRUNCATION. Reported from a real iPhone as COMMAN, the final D clipped. NOT reproducible in the harness, which measures the label at 65px inside a 95px cell at 390 and shows no clipping down to a 320 viewport — so this is fixed by construction, not by tuning to a measurement that could not be taken. The dock label drops from a fixed 10px with 1.6px tracking to clamp(8px,2.3vw,10px) with .06em tracking, so tracking now scales with the type instead of staying fixed as it shrinks. At 390 the label falls from 68% of its cell to 55%, leaving headroom for a device that renders it 83% wider than the harness does. The --hud-track-mid token is untouched: 46 other rules use it, and this is the dock own rule. Suspected trigger is iPhone Display Zoom, which reports a 320px viewport where the old label had only 12px of slack.
